data.title: PR-20 IMPL-06 policy verdict: pure typed verdict from recorded gates bound to the rt_ version; ContinueAndDisclose authority has no production issuer

data.body: [risk:high][info] No security finding. Failure modes: the verdict rejects malformed gate sets and prevents false allow through profile checks and failure dominance (policy.rs:292-347). Stale and forged claims are refused by recomputation (policy.rs:653-693). Edge cases: I checked every profile, gate 12 in all statuses, duplicate or missing gates, typed reason absence, and protected classifications. Rollback: computation is pure and typed refusals publish no state. Monitoring: surface GateListRefusal, VerdictRefusal, ClaimRefusal, and StaleVerdict. Keep promotion audit RED on any refusal. Validation: I statically inspected the full persisted range 322023b1..acf6a42f, all nine changed files, and relevant execution paths. Tests were inspected but not run under the metadata-only reviewer boundary. The risk:critical human gate remains separate.
